reply: That sounds like a stressful way to start the day — routine changes over the weekend can throw things off easily. I can't tell you exactly what to do with your dose, since that depends on which SSRI and how your body handles it, but the general rule people are given is: don't double up to "catch up," and if you're unsure whether to take it now or wait, a quick call to your pharmacist or prescriber's office is the safest bet — they answer this kind of question all the time. If you start feeling shaky, wired, or just off in a way that worries you, reach out to them today rather than waiting.
